question.title: [SYNTHETIC FIXTURE] How many of the 15 example members will abstain on 2026-07-15?
question.description: Synthetic fixture question for offline tests. Shaped like a MiniBench discrete question -- a small integer grid rather than a continuous range -- and never submitted anywhere.
question.resolution_criteria: Resolves to the number of example members recorded as abstaining in the published roll call for 2026-07-15.
question.fine_print: If no roll call is published that day, the question resolves to the next published roll call.
